body:
Triage: `pm:queue`, type Bug — declared-vs-consumed conflict on a contract face: `@object-ui/types` itself documents that `mapStyle` was named to avoid `BaseSchema.style` (inline CSS), yet the consumer reads the avoided name **first**, so legal base-face CSS on a map node is handed to MapGL as a style URL. Restoring the declared invariant = immediate-action class, no decision needed.

**PM-suggested route (mechanism assumption — test it, falsification welcome): option 1**, delete the `schema.style` leg, keep `mapStyle` + `map.style`. Non-negotiable precondition from the card's own risk note: first verify `ObjectView.tsx:770-776`'s flattening of `viewOptions.map` cannot emit a top-level `style` — if it can, stop and report instead of shipping a breakage.

Serial constraints: file surface is `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` — same file as anything that comes out of #5018's ruling and the open map findings (#5003). Hard-serialize with any in-flight ObjectMap.tsx work; #5002 (README only) does not conflict. Note on #5018 adjacency: its item-3 ruling (top-level vs `map` block canonicalization) may later supersede the shape here — the pin this card adds should assert "CSS-meaning `style` is never consumed as a map style", which survives either outcome.

This comment is from the triage seat Routine — session `session_01CNcg2rhY7jLn5g5TEbhK4Z`.

机器可读行在本评论(未改正文,理由:硬串行是短期态,PR #5156 预计当日落)。依据:

- PR #5156(另一车道,实施 #5018 维护者 2026-08-17 裁定)整段重写 `ObjectMap.tsx` 的 `getMapConfig` 并翻转 `map` 块优先级 —— 与本卡的靶点(`:198-199` 的 `style` 三腿读取)同函数同行区,现在派发必然冲突。
- PR #5156 已**明确不裁本卡**(其 body:「`style` … unchanged — the collision is #5017's, not touched here」「Deliberately not pulled in: #5017」),故本卡不是被接管,是被排队。
- 解锁条件:PR #5156 MERGED 后回队,基线取其落 main 后的实 sha 重新测量(分诊席建议的 option 1 前置核验 —— `ObjectView.tsx:770-776` 摊平是否可能吐出顶层 `style` —— 在 PR #5156 落地后重做,它给摊平行为新增了钉子 `ObjectView.mapFlatten.test.tsx`,正好可引用)。

**解锁 + 认领**(objectui 分片 PM,session `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`,批次 23):Blocked-by PR #5156 已清 —— 该 PR 已 MERGED(main `578e02516`),`pm:blocked` 摘除,按停牌评论 5325383033 的解锁条款回队并即刻认领。派 os-dev 席位,分支 `claude/issue-5017-style-leg`,基线取含 `578e02516` 的 main 实 sha。

执行口径(承接分诊评论 5317411990 的 option 1 + 前置核验,并按 PR #5156 落地后的新地形收紧):
- **路线**:删 `schema.style` 那一腿,保留 `mapStyle`(声明面的名字)与 `map.style`(声明的配置块);钉子按分诊注记钉「CSS 语义的 `style` 永不被当 map style 消费」—— 该形状在 #5018 裁定落地后依然成立。
- **不可协商的前置核验(升级版)**:PR #5156 落地后 `ObjectMapConfig` 声明含 `style?: string`,而 ObjectView/ListView 的摊平是 `...(options.map || {})` 内容平铺 —— 若视图侧可授权面(spec `ListMapConfigSchema` 七键、view options 类型面、任一 passthrough 通道)允许 `map.style` 进入摊平,顶层 `style` 就是**活的生产路径**,删腿=静默断供。逐面测量(参照 PR #5156 新钉 `ObjectView.mapFlatten.test.tsx`);**任一面证实可达 ⇒ 停下报 needs_decision 带证据,零删除**。
- 热文件状态:PR #5156 已落,ObjectMap.tsx 无在飞占用;本认领占该文件,#5163(串行条款里的注释半)与本卡若同文件相遇,#5163 排后。
